_comment: Manual AST overrides keyed by card baseCode, used when opcg_grammar.pegjs can't fully parse a card's effect. Each value is the full AST array (same shape peggy's parser.parse() returns). Populate using entries from needs_override.json (generated by buildEffectsAst.js).

OP02-026.triggerCondition: you play a Character with no base effect from your hand
